local_food_waste_reference.warning: Retrospective Qingdao operating reference; not a Dongjiakou design yield.

food_waste_transfer_function.energy_output: UNKNOWN until CH4 fraction, flare/use split and conversion efficiency are measured

wastewater_transfer_function.use_rule: theoretical ceiling only; requires measured eligible flow, COD, biodegradable fraction, COD removal and dissolved methane loss

conclusions: Qingdao provides a strong local operating precedent for food-waste dry anaerobic digestion.
Dongjiakou already has AO/MBBR wastewater biological treatment and high reclaimed-water reuse; new anaerobic treatment must be selective and incremental.
No municipal food waste is assumed available because regional treatment capacity already exists.
Digestate composting remains zero-credit until mass, contaminant, pathogen, maturity and off-take data close.
Future seawater-Mg to struvite coupling is physically coherent but receives zero credit until material purity, nutrient chemistry and conservation accounting close.
